clips.title: The story
paras: At Ratchet’s docks, Dizzywig’s ledger points away from harbor graft and toward the Southsea Freebooters. Gazlowe receives the records and prepares to reclaim his lost cargo.

Ratchet’s trade and its port bring constant logistical headaches. When a shipment fails to arrive, Gazlowe suspects bad harbor accounts or foul play on the piers. Wharfmaster Dizzywig examines the manifest and insists his books are clean. The intake records account for everything, so the missing merchandise never made it onto the dock.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Everything looks square from my records, friend. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.
Nothing else I can do for him. Oh... Though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?

clips.title: Completion
paras: No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.
Looks like I've got some goods to get back, friend. What do you say?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
